title: Bellman 评价与行动优化
caption: 两种 Bellman 递推都先把即时成本与随机转移下的后继价值期望相加。固定策略评价再按既定 π_t(a|s) 平均各行动价值；最优递推则在允许行动之间取最小值，不能把最小化移到随机后继状态上。图中 c_i=c_t(s,a_i)、π_i=π_t(a_i|s)；重复出现的 v_1、v_2 是同一对后继状态价值的两次展示，在左侧分别使用 V_{t+1}^π，在右侧使用 V_{t+1}^*，不暗示两边数值相同。有限时域的边界为 V_H=c_H；所有箭头展示价值的一步向后计算。 此处沿正文的成本口径，未添加折扣系数。
brief:
Scientific mechanism: FINITE-HORIZON, UNDISCOUNTED, COST-MINIMIZING Markov decision process. Compare fixed POLICY EVALUATION with ACTION OPTIMIZATION. Both start with next-time values and compute, for each action, the IMMEDIATE COST plus the transition-probability-weighted average of future values. Only the final action aggregation differs: the left evaluation branch averages action-values using the GIVEN probabilities of a fixed randomized policy; the right optimal branch takes the MINIMUM over permitted action-values. The source lecture uses reward maximization and discount gamma: neither maximum nor gamma belongs to this target. Do not draw any numbers or equations; they will be typeset later.
Create two clear corresponding computational schematics, one for fixed-policy averaging and one for minimum-action optimization. Each has exactly two available actions and exactly two successor state values; corresponding copied state/action structures must align visually and keep identical semantic colours and counts. The future-value inputs feed the transition expectation for EACH action, and each action's own immediate-cost input also enters its action-value calculation. Then the two action-values feed the current-state aggregation. Use distinct visual shape for random transition expectation (circle or circular node) and for the action/current-state aggregator (diamond or comparable distinct decision shape). Existing randomized-policy probabilities belong only at the final fixed-policy weighting stage, transition probabilities belong inside each action's future expectation. Do NOT minimize over chance outcomes, choose best successor, omit immediate cost, sample a single transition, change the cost to reward, or pretend evaluation is already optimal. No policy improvement loop in this figure, only a single backward Bellman step.
This is a VALUE CALCULATION diagram: orient arrows consistently from known future-value and immediate-cost inputs into expected action-values and from action-values into current-state value, making backward induction unmistakable; no second superposed forward-time arrows. Clear topological branches, no crossing ambiguity or detached node. Leave generous blank labels beside future values and costs, in/near both action expectation nodes and at the current-state aggregator; empty white margins above the two corresponding diagrams for small headings and below for compact formula labels. No icon decoration needed: decision/chance symbols are scientific shapes rather than cards. Use mainly white with pale Blue future/state objects, pale Green stochastic expectation, and pale Orange immediate-cost/action-operation hints. Distinguish the min aggregation from fixed-policy weighting with a restrained colour accent without giving the entire panel a coloured backdrop. There is no global title. Layout is freely chosen, not a copy of the references.
